label: Druantia III system
definition: A Druantia system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded DefenseFinder Druantia_III subtype locus represented by the Druantia_III rule row requiring both the Druantia_III__DruH and Druantia__DruE_1 profiles.
observations: Druantia III branch under Druantia system; distinct from the broader Druantia system, Druantia Type I, Type II, and Type IV contexts, individual druE or druH genes, DruE or DruH proteins, individual DefenseFinder HMM rows, exact late phage triggers, RecBCD-dependent DNA processing, Zorya II synergy, native host breadth, and other phage-defense systems.
